Bu form 4. sınıfa geçen (ve/veya seçmeli ders almaya hak kazanan) öğrenciler tarafından ders kayıtları öncesinde bir defaya mahsus olmak üzere doldurulacak ve akademik danışman ve öğrenci tarafından imzalanacaktır. Üç nüsha olarak hazırlanacak olan bu anlaşmanın bir nüshası öğrencide, bir nüshası akademik danışmanda ve son nüshası da Bilgisayar Mühendisliği Bölümü Sekreterliği’nde tutulacaktır .

Rules and Regulations:
Systems Engineering Focus Track (SyE) : Students following SyE track are required to take two required courses. In addition to these, at least three courses need to be taken from the area electives. The students can take one elective course from the general elective pool.
Software Engineering Focus Track (SoE) : Students following SoE track are required to take two required courses. In addition to these at least three courses need to be taken from the area electives. The students can take one elective course from the general elective pool.
Networks&Comp Sec. Focus Track (N&S) : Students following N&S track are required to take two required courses. In addition to these at least three courses need to be taken from the area electives. The students can take one elective course from the general elective pool.
Note 1 : If a course you have selected was not offered in time, you can replace it with another one from the same list. If a required course is not offered, another one from the area electives may be used to replace it.
